description:
Update a Sentry Alert (workflow), including notification actions and connections.
Use get_alert_rule with kind='issue' first to inspect the complete triggers and actionFilters configuration.
Use get_alert_options to discover notification actions, integrations, conditions, and available sources.
Omit fields to leave them unchanged. Pass null to clear owner or environment.
triggers replaces the trigger conditions. actionFilters replaces ALL action groups: copy the complete configuration, retain existing IDs, and change only the intended values. Omitted groups, conditions, and actions are removed.
For Slack or Microsoft Teams, change config.targetDisplay to the channel name and use integrationId for the workspace or team. Sentry resolves the channel ID. Slack also accepts an explicit new targetIdentifier; a copied old ID is cleared when the name or workspace changes.
Other actions use their provider's config and data. For Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, and email, update targetIdentifier to the channel, service, team, or recipient ID; changing only its display name does not change the destination.
Use addProjectSlugs/removeProjectSlugs to connect/disconnect a project's issue stream. Other monitors in that project remain connected. Use addDetectorIds/removeDetectorIds for individual monitors. Unmentioned connections are preserved.
Metric Monitor detection queries and thresholds are separate operations.
All-project connections require Sentry's all-project feature and an API token with org:write in addition to alerts:write.
A project-constrained session can only edit alerts affecting that project exclusively.
Requires alerts:write; reconnect OAuth if the existing token lacks it.
<examples>
update_alert_rule(organizationSlug='my-org', ruleIdOrName='12345', status='disabled')
update_alert_rule(organizationSlug='my-org', projectSlug='backend', ruleIdOrName='Notify backend team', frequencyMinutes=30)
</examples>

actionFilters.description: The complete list of action groups, conditions, and notification actions. Preserve their IDs and all unchanged groups and actions; omitted entries are removed. Slack and Microsoft Teams resolve config.targetDisplay as a channel name within integrationId. Other providers use their native config.targetIdentifier and data fields.

addDetectorIds.description: Existing detector IDs to connect, from get_alert_options(section='sources').

addProjectSlugs.description: Projects whose existing issue streams should be connected.

items.description: The project's slug. You can find a list of existing projects in an organization using the `find_projects()` tool.

frequencyMinutes.description: Minimum interval between notifications, in minutes.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

owner.description: Owner actor user:ID or team:ID. Pass null to clear.

anyOf.description: The project's slug. You can find a list of existing projects in an organization using the `find_projects()` tool.

The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'. For self-hosted Sentry installations, this parameter is usually not needed and should be omitted. You can find the correct regionUrl from the organization details using the `find_organizations()` tool.

removeDetectorIds.description: Detector IDs to disconnect. Other connections are retained.

removeProjectSlugs.description: Projects whose issue streams should be disconnected; other monitor connections are retained.

items.description: The project's slug. You can find a list of existing projects in an organization using the `find_projects()` tool.

ruleIdOrName.description: Workflow ID or exact alert name. Digit-only values are treated as IDs. Use IDs from get_alert_rule(kind='issue').

triggers.description: The complete trigger group. Preserve existing condition IDs when editing; omitted conditions are removed. Use the configuration returned by get_alert_rule.
